models.description:
Here's the model details text — ready to copy paste:

Title:
CreditWise Loan Approval Predictor
Subtitle:
Logistic Regression model for binary loan approval classification

Overview:
A logistic regression model trained on 975,800 realistic Indian loan applications to predict whether a loan will be approved or rejected. Achieves 83.1% accuracy on test data.

Training Data:
Dataset: CreditWise Loan Approval Dataset
Rows: 975,800 (after outlier removal from 1,000,000)
Features: 27 engineered features
Target: Loan_Approved (1 = Approved, 0 = Rejected)

Performance:
Accuracy — 83.1%
Precision — 74.8%
Recall — 64.6%
F1 Score — 69.3%

Input Features:
Applicant_Income, Coapplicant_Income, Age, Dependents, Existing_Loans, Savings, Loan_Amount, Loan_Term, Education_Level, Employment_Status, Marital_Status, Loan_Purpose, Property_Area, Gender, Employer_Category, Collateral_Ratio, DTI_Ratio_sq, Credit_Score_sq

Framework:
Scikit-learn
Logistic Regression (max_iter=1000)

Files:
loan_model.pkl — trained logistic regression model
scaler.pkl — feature scaler

Usage:
import joblib
import pandas as pd
model = joblib.load('loan_model.pkl')
prediction = model.predict(input_df)
probability = model.predict_proba(input_df)[0][1]

Live Demo:
https://creditwise-rxt6.onrender.com
GitHub:
https://github.com/mayankchouhan263-crypto/CreditWiseLoanSystem
Dataset:
https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mayankchouhan263/creditwise-loan-approval-dataset

# Model Summary
This model is imported from the Hugging Face Transformers repository. It provides implementations of transformer-based architectures used for natural language processing tasks such as text classification, question answering, and text generation.

## Usage
The model can be used with the Hugging Face Transformers library in Python.

Example:

from transformers import pipeline

classifier = pipeline("sentiment-analysis")
result = classifier("Kaggle models are useful!")

print(result)

## System
This model is part of a larger machine learning ecosystem and can be used with Python environments supporting PyTorch or TensorFlow.

## Implementation requirements
Python, Hugging Face Transformers library, and optionally GPU support for faster inference.
